notes.market: fixed stable/watch, not historical macro observations
notes.universe: current 505 constituents/instruments and current sector classification
notes.sell: sale next open vs same holding sold horizon close; cash interest zero, no shorts
notes.precision: fraction of sell picks whose horizon close is below next-open price, not recall across all falling stocks
notes.samples: overlapping observations; paired complete TOP3 dates; 63-trading-day block intervals
notes.screening: five alternatives, ten stable primary comparisons; no tuning after results
